mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_report ( room_id, overall_score, ai_comment, comp_expertise, comp_expertise_detail, comp_logic, comp_logic_detail, comp_commu, comp_commu_detail, comp_culture, comp_culture_detail, comp_pressure, comp_pressure_detail, speech_wpm, speech_filler, checklist ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{overallScore}, #{aiComment}, #{compExpertise}, #{compExpertiseDetail}, #{compLogic}, #{compLogicDetail}, #{compCommu}, #{compCommuDetail}, #{compCulture}, #{compCultureDetail}, #{compPressure}, #{compPressureDetail}, #{speechWpm}, #{speechFiller}, #{checklist} )

INSERT INTO report_applicant (room_id, is_user, applicant_id, score, strength, weakness) VALUES
(#{item.roomId}, #{item.isUser}, #{item.applicantId}, #{item.score}, #{item.strength}, #{item.weakness})

INSERT INTO report_question (room_id, scenario_id, question_seq, score, label, feedback, tags) VALUES
(#{item.roomId}, #{item.scenarioId}, #{item.questionSeq}, #{item.score}, #{item.label}, #{item.feedback}, #{item.tags})
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, room_id, overall_score, ai_comment, comp_expertise, comp_expertise_detail, comp_logic, comp_logic_detail, comp_commu, comp_commu_detail, comp_culture, comp_culture_detail, comp_pressure, comp_pressure_detail, speech_wpm, speech_filler, checklist, created_at FROM interview_report WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT id, room_id, is_user, applicant_id, score, strength, weakness FROM report_applicant WHERE room_id = (SELECT room_id FROM interview_report WHERE report_id = #{reportId})

SELECT rq.id, rq.room_id AS roomId, rq.scenario_id AS scenarioId, s_q.question_seq AS questionSeq, s_q.speech_text AS questionText, COALESCE(s_ans.answer_text, s_ans.speech_text) AS answerText, s_ans.turn_role AS turnRole, s_ans.turn_ref_id AS turnRefId, rq.score, rq.label, rq.feedback, rq.tags FROM interview_report ir JOIN interview_scenario s_q ON s_q.room_id = ir.room_id AND s_q.turn_role = 'INTERVIEWER' AND s_q.question_seq > 0 LEFT JOIN report_question rq ON rq.room_id = ir.room_id AND rq.scenario_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM interview_scenario s2 WHERE s2.scenario_id = rq.scenario_id AND s2.question_seq = s_q.question_seq ) LEFT JOIN interview_scenario s_ans ON s_ans.scenario_id = rq.scenario_id WHERE ir.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY s_q.question_seq, s_ans.turn_role

SELECT ir.report_id AS reportId, u.user_email AS userEmail, u.user_name AS userName, room.company_name AS companyName FROM interview_report ir JOIN interview_room room ON room.room_id = ir.room_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = room.user_id WHERE ir.notified_at IS NULL AND room.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND room.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY <= NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_report SET notified_at = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
